findings.title: Refresh tokens stored in renderer localStorage (plaintext)
findings.resolution: Session storage moved to main-process safeStorage-backed store (DPAPI/Keychain/libsecret); plaintext fallback flagged 'plain:true', never silent; corrupt/foreign ciphertext degrades to sign-in
findings.evidence: desktop/src/main/secureStore.ts, desktop/src/shared/secureStoreCore.ts (5 tests), renderer supabase.ts custom storage adapter

findings.title: Upload queue had no account owner; cross-account upload possible on shared machines
findings.resolution: queue-owner.json + quarantine on user switch (queue-{oldUser}.json, resumable)

findings.title: Renderer isolation
findings.resolution: contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, sandbox:true on all three windows (main, dictation overlay, floating controller); verified in Phase 7 review

findings.title: Navigation and window controls
findings.resolution: will-navigate prevented; setWindowOpenHandler denies all except https->system browser; single-instance lock

findings.title: IPC surface minimality and validation
findings.resolution: Segment paths derived main-side from validated (uuid, 1..2000, ext regex); settings patches key-validated + normalized; openExternal https-only; secure store keys length-bounded; preload channel allowlist

findings.title: CSP
findings.resolution: CSP meta present in index.html (self + supabase/degram connect) and strict 'none'-default in overlay.html and floating.html

findings.title: Model supply chain
findings.resolution: Pinned HTTPS release URL; archive + per-file SHA-256 verified before use; version markers; downloaded files never executed

findings.title: Local Only enforcement
findings.resolution: Provider selection refuses cloud under privacy:'local-only' even when sole provider; recordings made locally are never uploaded

findings.title: Reflected XSS in OAuth loopback response page
findings.resolution: Provider-controlled error_description was interpolated unescaped into the loopback HTML response; response is now text/plain so no markup can execute. Found in the PR #19 review pass

findings.title: Server writes without user_id (settings/onboarding rows and events)
findings.resolution: user_settings/user_onboarding upserts and onboarding_events inserts now carry the signed-in user_id with onConflict (the tables have no auth.uid() defaults); found in the PR #19 review pass against the real migrations

findings.title: queue:rotate IPC accepted unvalidated ids used in file names
findings.resolution: current and stored owner ids must match the UUID shape before comparison or quarantine rename

findings.title: OAuth state not double-checked by main process
findings.resolution: State is validated by Supabase's PKCE verifier binding during exchange; loopback capture rejects mismatched state when one was issued. Documented rather than duplicated

findings.title: openExternal accepts any https URL from renderer
findings.resolution: A compromised renderer could open a phishing tab in the system browser; cannot exfiltrate app data or run code. Accepted; window.open is denied

findings.title: Local-only plaintext fallback when safeStorage unavailable
findings.resolution: Recorded, flagged in the store file; Linux without libsecret is the realistic case; distribution gate notes it
